Drawing DWG-A-0002 rev A, sheet 1/1: System A – air path schematic.
Components:
- A-CMP: Electric turbo air compressor
- A-AIR: Air inlet filter
- A-HUM: Membrane humidifier
- A-EXH: Exhaust outlet
- A-BPV: Humidifier bypass valve
- A-STK: Fuel cell stack
Line list:
- L01 Air from A-AIR (Air inlet filter) to A-CMP (Electric turbo air compressor)
- L02 Air from A-CMP (Electric turbo air compressor) to A-HUM (Membrane humidifier)
- L03 Humidified air from A-HUM (Membrane humidifier) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L04 Cathode exhaust from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-HUM (Membrane humidifier)
- L05 Cathode exhaust from A-HUM (Membrane humidifier) to A-EXH (Exhaust outlet)
- L14 Air from A-CMP (Electric turbo air compressor) to A-BPV (Humidifier bypass valve)
- L15 Air from A-BPV (Humidifier bypass valve) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
Notes: Schematic, not to scale. Sensors and check valves are not shown.
